modelsView.title: Installed models
modelsView.intro: Placement is read from the GPU driver, not assumed. A model that spills to system RAM is bound by memory bandwidth — routing work to one that fits is worth roughly 8x on this hardware.
modelsView.marginal_hint: Fits only while little else uses the GPU.
modelsView.cloud_hint: Runs remotely; local memory does not apply.
modelsView.spilledCostHint: Measured on this kind of machine: the same job took 13 s on a model that fits in VRAM and 431 s on one that does not — about ten times per line written. Your choice stands; this is only the price.
